treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Cyprus and the Swiss Confederation for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2014, as amended by Protocol 2020)
eif_quote: Abkommen vom 25. Juli 2014 zwischen der Schweizerischen Eidgenossenschaft und der Republik Zypern zur Vermeidung der Doppelbesteuerung auf dem Gebiet der Steuern vom Einkommen und vom Vermögen (mit Prot.) — SR 0.672.925.81, dateEntryInForce 2015-10-15 (Fedlex SPARQL metadata)
source_title: CY–CH Convention 2014 (English, Cyprus MoF PDF) and amending Protocol of 20 July 2020 (Official Gazette Annex VII No. 4259, 24.7.2020, Greek/French/English)

rates.quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2, such dividends shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting State in which the company paying the dividends is a resident if the dividends are beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State that is a) a company (other than a partnership) the capital of which is wholly or partly divided into shares and which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends during an uninterrupted period of at least one year;

However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
Interest arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.basis: treaty art. 28A (added by Protocol 2020, Art. V)
ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Art. 29(2)(a): WHT provisions effective for amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (EIF 15.10.2015 -> 1.1.2016). Dividend 0% also for pension funds (Art. 10(3)(b)) and Government/political subdivision/local authority/central bank (Art. 10(3)(c)) - not modelled. Protocol para. 2: the one-year holding period in Art. 10(3)(a) is satisfied even if fulfilled after the dividend payment date. Before the 2020 Protocol, Protocol para. 1 contained a general anti-abuse clause ('The provisions of this Convention shall not apply in case of abuse'), deleted by Protocol 2020 Art. V(2) and replaced by PPT Art. 28A. Protocol 2020 in force 3.11.2021 (per treaties_merged/SIF list), Art. VI(2)(a): WHT effect from 1 January of the following year -> 2022-01-01. Not an MLI covered agreement.
